correctness.rationale: For each length, a one-absorption-correcting code is exactly a family of source words whose distinct output balls are pairwise disjoint. The package constructs every absorption ball directly from saturated adjacent addition together with the terminal-missing event, then solves both the output set-packing integer program and the equivalent conflict-graph maximum independent-set integer program. Both formulations report zero MIP gap and optima \(3,6,13,29\) for lengths two through five; the supplied witnesses are checked directly. An independent reconstruction of the set-packing matrix reproduced all four optima with exact integrality and zero solver gap. The claim is a finite exhaustive optimization, so an exact integer-program optimum is an appropriate complete certificate of the upper bounds.
residual_risks: The upper bounds are computer-assisted mixed-integer proofs rather than proof-assistant certificates.
No claim is made beyond length five.
